description: This file is a PHP script that tests issue creation in Redmine via its raw API interface. It loads configuration for multiple Redmine sites, selects one, and creates a new issue with specific attributes using the Redmine PHP API library.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class representing the Redmine API interface used to communicate with the Redmine server.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize the Redmine API client with the server URL and API key.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Method to create a new Redmine issue using a SimpleXML object.
